content.title: About
content.content: Mashed potato NFS is a ready‑to‑eat product made from selected potatoes processed with the “Non‑Fried Spray” (NFS) technology. The mash has a smooth, creamy texture, a mild buttery flavor, and retains most of the nutrients of the original potato.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The NFS process preserves up to 90 % of vitamin C, which is often lost in conventional cooking.
The mash is produced without artificial preservatives or colorants.
One serving (100 g) provides about 80 kcal, making it suitable for low‑calorie diets.
Potatoes used for NFS are grown in environmentally controlled regions without genetically modified seeds.

items.title: Rich in potassium
items.content: Potassium helps maintain normal fluid balance and supports healthy heart function.

items.title: Source of vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C is a powerful antioxidant that supports immunity and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The mash contains less than 0.2 g of fat per 100 g, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Provides vitamin B6
items.content: Vitamin B6 is involved in protein metabolism and neurotransmitter synthesis.

items.title: Potato allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience an allergic reaction to potatoes.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some variants may contain added salt; people with hypertension should monitor intake.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Potatoes have a high glycemic index, so those with diabetes should consider portion size.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the mash in a microwave or on the stovetop, then stir in butter, milk, cheese, or herbs to taste. It works well as a side dish for meat, fish, or vegetable plates.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the mash refrigerated at 0 °C – 4 °C in its original packaging. Once opened, consume within 3 days. Discard if any off‑odor or discoloration appears.
